Subject: Vendor enrollment: Sable Systems — Finance registry + virtual IBAN remittance

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

We're starting vendor enrollment for Sable's new Finance Vendor Registry and need Redwood added as a supplier so our AP can route EUR payments to a virtual IBAN tied to the Redwood sub-entity. Procurement asked for a single packet that includes everything our AP needs to create the vendor record in Coupa (legal entity names + VAT/TIN per entity, bank remittance instructions, preferred invoice template, and an example invoice showing tax allocation across two legal entities).

Attached is our onboarding checklist with the fields our vendor portal will enforce (Sable_vendor_requirements.xlsx). A few clarifications we need from you to complete registration:
- Confirm legal company name(s) and the VAT/Tax IDs for the invoicing entities that Redwood expects us to create in our registry.
- Provide a sample invoice that shows a multi-entity split (we need line-level tax amounts plus a summary per legal entity).
- Confirm if Redwood can supply a mapping file (CSV) for remit instructions so our AP can automatically assign the correct virtual IBAN for EUR vs GBP vs USD.
- Any required contract or W-8/W-9 / EU VAT certificate our vendor team should attach.

Target date for our vendor record cutover is next Thursday (2027-01-07). Can you confirm whether we have everything to hit that date or what the expected lead time is?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Finance Operations Manager | Sable Systems
elena.rossi@sablesys.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Hi Elena — thanks for the checklist and the heads-up. I've pulled together a short AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice that match Sable's requested fields. Attaching: Redwood_AP_onboarding_packet_v2.pdf and sample_invoice_multi-entity.xlsx.

Quick summary of what you'll find in the packet and our asks so your portal has a clean first pass:
- Legal entity & tax: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — EIN: 12-3456789; Redwood Inference UK Ltd. (UK) — VAT GB999 9999 73. We can also provide additional jurisdiction entities if you need (list on page 2 of the packet).
- Invoice format: we provide PDF for human review plus a CSV that mirrors line items (your Coupa ingest team can use it). The sample shows two billing entities split by line items with tax calculation per entity and a per-entity subtotal.
- Virtual IBAN: Redwood uses partner bank virtual IBANs for EUR settlements. We'll provide a remit mapping CSV (vendor_mapping.csv) that pairs currency -> virtual IBAN -> Redwood ledger code. For security, we prefer to exchange full bank credentials via secure portal or signed DocuSign form — I can send a secured link or share with your AP contact directly.
- Required docs: EU VAT cert (GDPR-safe copy) and a completed vendor form for tax withholding records (DocuSign link below).
- PO matching: please ensure Coupa sends the PO number on the invoice header and line item PO refs for split-billing scenarios; our system matches on full PO number.

Estimated timeline: if we get the completed vendor form and VAT cert by EOB Wednesday (2026-12-30) we can return the mapping CSV same-day and request that your registry team create the vendor record by 2027-01-04. Final bank visibility (virtual IBAN acceptance) depends on your bank cutover but usually clears within 2 business days after registration.

DocuSign (vendor form): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123xyz

Let me know if you want me to loop in our Finance lead for any GL / ledger mapping questions — cc'd Naomi if that helps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra

- GL / ledger codes: our invoices include a line-level 'internal_gl' field. If your Coupa mapping requires Sable-specific GL codes, please share the csv template and we'll populate on our side.
- Tax treatment: for multi-entity invoices we will send net amounts per entity and the VAT amount per line. We need Sable to ensure the vendor record supports multiple legal entity IDs under a single supplier umbrella.
- Remittance mapping: we will provide vendor_mapping.csv, but to finalize banking details we require a signed NDA or secure portal exchange (banking info will not be emailed).

Small request on timing: if Sable can confirm the portal field names for 'legal_name', 'tax_id', 'bank_identifier' and an example PO payload that Coupa sends on create we can template the CSV outbound for import.
